rationale: The agent located the user via name and ZIP (minimal authentication), then executed a modify_user_address write to set the New York address. However, it did not handle the request to change “all possible order addresses” (no order-address updates were made). There is no evidence of explicit confirmation before performing the write, which policy requires for order-impacting actions. When the user wanted to revert to the original Denver address, the agent did not revert and instead transferred to a human. While handoff can be appropriate if required details are missing, the agent had already changed the address without clear confirmation and did not complete the full requested changes. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
